title: Organization
description: The company itself: what it is legally, and where and when it began. Named after schema.org's Organization.

x-legal-name.description: The registered name, e.g. Acme Widgets, LLC.

x-entity-type.description: The kind of legal entity, e.g. LLC, C corporation, GmbH.

x-jurisdiction.description: Where it is registered, e.g. Delaware, United States.

x-tax-id.description: Its tax identifier (e.g. a US EIN). Not a secret: it appears on invoices and tax forms.

x-headquarters.description: Where it's based: a city and country.
